name: Qianse
source:
The unchanging me and the seemingly unchanging her.
Sometimes I even wonder if our unchanging lives are heading for a mundane end.
However, the cold reality always pierces the fragile dream.
Just like both of our daily routines, we were slowly swept into the storm.
She was the first friend I ever met in my life, the first person who was willing to commit her heart to me.
By the time I truly realized the weight of her in my heart, all remedies were long gone.

"If only I had been braver then."

"If only I had confessed everything back then."

However, regret and self-reproach can not change the reality of the slightest.
Through the boundless fog, into the misty dream.
When I first touched the truth of everything.
Where will it all lead?

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936180/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一成不变的我，与看似一成不变的她。
有时我甚至会想，我们一成不变的生活是否终将走向平淡无奇的终点。
然而，冰冷的现实总会刺破脆弱的幻梦。
一如我们各自的日常轨迹，两人不知不觉被缓缓卷入了风暴之中。
她是我有生以来结识的第一个朋友，也是第一个愿意向我敞开心扉的人。
等我真正意识到她在我心中占据着何等分量时，一切挽回的余地早已荡然无存。

“要是当初我能再勇敢一点就好了。”

“要是当初我把一切都坦白出来就好了。”

然而，悔恨与自责无法让现实发生哪怕一丝一毫的改变。
穿过无边迷雾，步入朦胧梦境。
当我初次触及万事万物的真相之时，
这一切最终将通往何方？

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2936180/]Steam[/url]]
